description: Ingest pipeline for GPU metrics. Validates temperature and utilisation ranges, derives thermal throttle warning.

script.description: Validate GPU utilisation is 0-100% and temperature is reasonable
script.source: if (ctx.gpu?.utilisation_pct != null && (ctx.gpu.utilisation_pct < 0 || ctx.gpu.utilisation_pct > 100)) { throw new Exception('gpu.utilisation_pct must be 0-100, got: ' + ctx.gpu.utilisation_pct); } if (ctx.gpu?.temperature_c != null && (ctx.gpu.temperature_c < -10 || ctx.gpu.temperature_c > 150)) { throw new Exception('gpu.temperature_c out of plausible range: ' + ctx.gpu.temperature_c); }

script.description: Derive thermal throttle warning when junction temp exceeds 95C
script.source: def temp = ctx.gpu?.hotspot_c != null ? ctx.gpu.hotspot_c : ctx.gpu?.temperature_c; if (temp != null) { ctx.gpu.thermal_throttle_warning = temp > 95.0; } else { ctx.gpu.thermal_throttle_warning = false; }
